contentSummary: This is the unit/company page for Jai Jagdish Ship Breakers Pvt. Ltd., one of Sachdeva Group's two Alang recycling units. It carries a single paragraph of history (the group has been in ship breaking since Alang began in 1983; this unit was formed in 1998 and has recycled 35 ships to date), a "43 Years of Excellence" badge, a yard-contact panel (Plot No 66, Alang Ship Breaking Yard, Bhavnagar; +91 278 2429573; info@sachdevagroup.in), and then the page's real payload: a 35-row "List of Ships Recycled" table with SR No, ship name, ship type, LDT MT and financial year. The vessel record spans FY1998-99 to FY2019-20, totals 377,974.798 LDT (avg ~10,799 LDT, largest DIAMOND JASMINE at 41,838…
